headlineNote: Previous issue (2026-10-28) used a claim-style headline. Suggested shape: lead with the single robots.txt token (the '1 line' hook), optionally pair with '90 of 99' from the research section.

news.why: Fast-moving standards story that breaks cleanly into three mechanism points: what the token is (one policy token in robots.txt, no new grammar), who honors it and when (Anthropic started; Google 2027; Microsoft Bing Feb 1, 2027; OpenAI attributed to secondary reports only, or left out), and what it does not cover (voluntary, training only, not retroactive, not finished at IETF; Hake counterpoint). Leads because it affects every website owner. Caveats: attribute OpenAI details as 'according to' secondary reports, or omit; do not mention regulators, codes of practice or government; do not imply Meta or Amazon support (acknowledgment is not commitment).

research.why: Headline finding is numeric (90 of 99 memory-system results below naive RAG; OpenViking 31.8 vs 72.2; info-loss rates; src-aug fix 73.6 to 82.8, tax 12.0 to 5.2) and the benefit/tax split is easy to present as 4-6 bolded figures. Avoids explainer (used in 2 of the last 6 issues) and claim-vs-evidence (3 of the last 6). Caveats to carry: preprint, not yet peer-reviewed; authors' own numbers; LLM judge Qwen3.6-27B is also an answering model; subsets used for two benchmarks; PlugMem is from overlapping authors; independent preprints agree but are also preprints; counterpoints (Harness the Memory, vendor view) go in the framing or the last figure.

invention.why: The honest caveat is the comparison itself: Qwenputer vs stock Qwen3.5-4B vs a Python tool call or ordinary RISC-V emulator (exactness, speed, size 18.8 GB vs about half, needs custom RvChat driver). A table makes the hobby-project limits plain in under 350 words. Caveats: one person's hobby project, self-reported numbers on 40-problem sets, no replication; frame as this week's most discussed build (HN Oct 29), blog dated Oct 22 predates the window; do NOT use the doomformer description in topics.json (wrong); nesformer may get a one-line mention only.
